craft_notes: Sthāyin: knower-joy (both modes admitted). Sanskrit first: long object + vā-alternatives + winner → L4 sets object line 1, admission line 2. Rows: row 1 (itself-last — tattvavit closes as Real closes). Rupture: comma after self — object held, modes stated. Close: end-weight on the Real (capital kept — reality as Real). Minimal pass: 'the Real itself' for tattvavit predicate (knower-implied). Read aloud: taste, risen/gathered, Real. Rejected: 'Brahman' — killed: reality kept (tattva, not Brahman); 'engrossed' for sanniruddha — killed: gathered plain.

lines: Who wins that nondual wakened taste of self,
risen or inward-gathered, knows the Real itself.
l4.sanskrit_cite: abhedabodhasaṃbodhasvarūpānubhavasthitim / vyutthitaḥ sanniruddho vā labhate yaḥ sa tattvavit

reads_against.argmap: Risen or absorbed, who gains the nonduality-state is the knower of reality.
c1_essence: Risen or absorbed, winner of the nondual taste knows reality.
